scenes.spoken_script: Forensic accountants flag exactly this — and the data is sitting in plain sight.

Indiana law says big purchases need a public vote. Watch what happens when someone writes many checks just under the limit — same vendor, same year, no single line big enough to trigger oversight. The flagged line: Gibson FY2024: 'WATER' received 69 disbursements each under $49,999, totaling $1,037,673 — possible bid-threshold splitting (IC 36-1-12-19 pattern). Could be innocent — but it's public money and the explanation should be on the record.
